    • Class au.csiro.pathling.config.LocalTerminologyConfiguration

      class LocalTerminologyConfiguration extends Object implements Serializable
      serialVersionUID:
      4470306870886711570L

      • Serialized Fields

        • defaultSnomedEdition
          String defaultSnomedEdition
          The SNOMED CT module identifier of the edition to prefer when resolving unversioned SNOMED references and more than one edition is present in the store (for example 32506021000036107 for the Australian edition). When absent, an unversioned reference in the presence of multiple editions resolves to an ambiguity error.
        • dialectAliases
          Map<@NotBlank String,@Pattern(regexp="\\d{6,18}") String> dialectAliases
          Additional dialect tags recognised when a caller asks for a display in a particular language, mapping a language tag to the identifier of the SNOMED CT language reference set that serves it (for example en-NZ to 271000210107). An entry for a tag that is already recognised replaces the built-in mapping for that tag. Tags outside both the built-in table and this map remain reachable through the private-use dialect extension form.

          This affects the selection of a display and of designations only. It has no bearing on the import, or on value set expansion, subsumption, translation or validation.

        • expansionCacheSize
          @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(1L) int expansionCacheSize
          The maximum number of value set expansions cached per executor JVM.
        • storagePath
          String storagePath
          The location of the terminology store. Any path accessible through the Hadoop FileSystem API is supported (for example file://, s3a://, abfs://, hdfs://). Required when the terminology mode is local; the requirement is enforced by the class-level validation on TerminologyConfiguration.

      6321330066417583745L

      • Serialized Fields

        • clientId
          String clientId
          A client ID for use with the client credentials grant.
        • clientSecret
          String clientSecret
          A client secret for use with the client credentials grant (symmetric authentication).
        • enabled
          @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull boolean enabled
          Enables authentication of requests to the terminology server.
        • privateKeyJwk
          String privateKeyJwk
          A private key in JWK format for use with private key JWT authentication (asymmetric authentication). If provided, this takes precedence over clientSecret.
        • scope
          String scope
          A scope value for use with the client credentials grant.

          @URL String tokenEndpoint
          An OAuth2 token endpoint for use with the client credentials grant.
        • tokenExpiryTolerance
          @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(0L) long tokenExpiryTolerance
          The minimum number of seconds that a token should have before expiry when deciding whether to send it with a terminology request.
        • useFormForBasicAuth
          @jakarta.validation.constraints.NotNull boolean useFormForBasicAuth
          When true, sends client credentials in the request body instead of using HTTP Basic authentication. Only applies when using symmetric (client secret) authentication.

          Setting this option to true will enable additional logging of the details of requests to the terminology service.
